reproduction_target: De novo genome assembly and annotation of Gonipterus sp. n. 2 from Oxford Nanopore + Illumina data, and downstream comparative-genomic analysis of cytochrome P450 gene family expansion. Computational chain: Guppy v5.1.12 basecalling, FastQC v0.11.9 QC, Trimmomatic v0.38 trimming (DNA and RNA), JELLYFISH v1.1.12 + GenomeScope 2.0 k-mer genome-size/heterozygosity estimation (k=21), NECAT long-read assembly, minimap 2.0 + racon v1.3.1 (3 iterations) polishing, BWA v0.7.17 + Pilon v1.23 (3 iterations) short-read polishing, a final racon round, Purge Haplotigs haplotig removal, BUSCO v4.0.5 (insecta_odb10) completeness assessment, RepeatModeler v2.0.2 + RepeatMasker v4.1.2 repeat library and soft-masking, HISAT2 v2.2.1 RNA-seq alignment, GenomeThreader v1.7.4 protein spliced alignment, Braker3 structural annotation with Augustus, Blast2GO PRO v1.20.14 on CLC Genomics Workbench v20.0.4 functional annotation and P450 identification (Pfam=00067), OrthoFinder v2.5.5 orthogroup inference (Diamond sensitive, inflation 1.5), muscle v3.8.31 alignment, IQ-TREE v2.1.2 gene trees, ASTRAL v5.7.7 species tree, RAxML v8.2.11 branch-length optimisation, ultrametric transform (tool not named) and CAFE v5 gene-family expansion/contraction testing. All wet-lab work (HMW DNA extraction, gut-tissue DNA extraction, RNA extraction, Illumina TruSeq library prep and HiSeq sequencing, Nanopore SQK-LSK110 library prep and PromethION sequencing) is out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool-invocation, taken from Methods subsections 3.1 (DNA extraction and genome sequencing), 3.2 (RNA extraction and sequencing), 3.3 (Genome assembly and annotation) and 3.4 (Analysis of the expansion of the cytochrome P450 gene family). Trimmomatic v0.38 is counted twice (C2 on genomic Illumina reads, C4 on RNA-seq reads) because the two invocations act on different inputs. The two racon invocations are counted separately (C9 post-NECAT, C12 post-Pilon) because they occupy different positions in the polishing chain. Augustus is folded into the Braker3 step (C19) because the paper states it was used as the gene predictor inside that pipeline; Diamond is folded into the OrthoFinder step (C21) for the same reason. The ultrametric transform of the rooted RAxML tree (C26) is counted as a separate step because the paper names no tool for it and CAFE requires it as input. Blast2GO PRO on CLC Genomics Workbench is a proprietary GUI application and is scored code=0. No code repository, script, notebook, command line or configuration file is provided anywhere in the paper, and there is no code-availability statement. Six wet-lab procedures counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Illumina read quality assessment with FastQC (v0.11.9) (https://www.bioinformatics.babraham.ac.uk/projects/fastqc/); no thresholds or report criteria stated

Trimming of genomic Illumina reads with Trimmomatic (v0.38): 'low-quality bases and remaining Illumina adaptors were removed' - no adapter FASTA, no ILLUMINACLIP/LEADING/TRAILING/SLIDINGWINDOW/MINLEN settings given
Nanopore basecalling with Guppy (v5.1.12) from PromethION FLO-PRO002 / SQK-LSK110 output; no basecalling model or config named
Trimming of RNA-seq reads with Trimmomatic (v0.38): 'Adaptors and low-quality RNA sequences of reads were removed' - no parameters given
k-mer counting on trimmed Illumina reads with JELLYFISH v.1.1.12, k-mer value of 21
Genome size and heterozygosity estimation with GenomeScope 2.0 from the k=21 histogram; ploidy setting, max k-mer coverage and model fitting options not stated

Long-read assembly of uncorrected Nanopore reads with the NECAT pipeline (no version given), using the GenomeScope-estimated genome size and a minimum read length of 3 kb; the numeric genome size actually supplied and the NECAT config file are not reported
Mapping of raw Nanopore reads to the NECAT assembly with minimap 2.0 (name/version ambiguous: 'minimap 2.0' cited to Li 2018, i.e. minimap2); no preset (e.g. -x map-ont) or other options stated
Consensus polishing of the NECAT assembly with racon v1.3.1 for three iterations using the Nanopore mapping file; per-iteration remapping procedure and racon options not stated
Mapping of trimmed Illumina reads to the racon-polished genome with BWA v0.7.17 (cited to Vasimuddin et al. 2019, i.e. the BWA-MEM2 paper - tool identity ambiguous); no algorithm or options stated
Short-read polishing with Pilon v1.23 for three iterations; --fix mode, --diploid and other options not stated
Final polishing round with racon (version implied v1.3.1) using trimmed Illumina data mapped to the Pilon-polished assembly; the mapper used for this round is not named
Haplotig removal from the primary polished assembly with Purge Haplotigs (no version given); no coverage cutoffs (-l/-m/-h), no alignment coverage or maximum match thresholds stated
Completeness assessment with BUSCO v.4.0.5 using the 'insecta_odb10' lineage dataset; run mode (genome/protein) and the ODB10 release date not stated
De novo repeat library construction with RepeatModeler v2.0.2 (http://www.repeatmasker.org/RepeatModeler/); LTR pipeline flag and search engine not stated
Genome soft-masking with RepeatMasker v 4.1.2 using the RepeatModeler de novo library; search engine, Repbase/Dfam library version and sensitivity settings not stated

Alignment of three RNA-seq datasets (SAMN19700001 reproductive tissue, SAMN19700000 alimentary tissue, PRJNA1189815 gut) to the masked draft genome with HISAT2 v2.2.1; no options, no index build command, no per-sample handling stated

Spliced protein alignment of the proteomes of the selected coleopteran species (Table 2, sourced from InsectBase accessed June 2023) to the genome with GenomeThreader v1.7.4; species scoring matrix, similarity and coverage cutoffs not stated

Structural annotation with the Braker3 pipeline (major release only, no point version), using Augustus as the gene predictor with the aligned transcriptomes and proteomes as evidence; GeneMark/ProtHint settings, hint construction and Augustus training parameters not stated

Functional annotation of predicted proteins and P450 identification with the Blast2GO PRO plug-in v1.20.14 on CLC Genomics Workbench v20.0.4, using protein domain Pfam = 00067; proprietary commercial GUI, no BLAST database or e-value thresholds stated, no InterPro/Pfam release version

Orthogroup inference across Gonipterus sp. n. 2, 11 coleopteran species and 2 outgroups with OrthoFinder v2.5.5, Diamond in sensitive mode (-S) and inflation factor 1.5; Diamond version not given, exact input proteome files/versions not listed beyond Table 2
Multiple sequence alignment of single-copy ortholog protein sequences with muscle v3.8.31 (cited to Edgar 2022, i.e. the Muscle5 paper - version/citation mismatch); no alignment options stated
Gene tree inference with IQ-TREE v 2.1.2 (cited to the ModelFinder paper); substitution model, model-selection criterion, bootstrap scheme and seed not stated
Species tree inference from individual gene trees with ASTRAL v5.7.7; no options, no gene-tree filtering or collapsing criteria stated
Rooting on B. mori and C. carnea and branch-length optimisation with RAxML v8.2.11 on the concatenated alignment of all single-copy genes; substitution model, partitioning scheme and seed not stated

Transformation of the rooted phylogenetic tree into an ultrametric tree for CAFE input - 'The rooted phylogenetic tree was transformed into an ultrametric tree'; no tool, no method, no calibration points and no version given

Gene family expansion and contraction testing with CAFE v5 (major release only) on the ultrametric tree and OrthoFinder gene counts; lambda/error model, filtering of large families and significance threshold not stated (only asterisk p-thresholds in the figure legend)

HMW DNA extraction from Gonipterus sp. n. 2 abdominal tissue (Greytown, KwaZulu-Natal, Sept 2021) with the Monarch HMW DNA Extraction Kit for tissue, with stated modifications to lysis and centrifugation steps
Gut-cleared adult DNA extraction (Melmoth, KwaZulu-Natal, Oct 2020) with the E.N.Z.A Insect DNA Kit (Omega Bio-tek), Proteinase K / CTL buffer overnight 37 C lysis
Illumina TruSeq PCR-free paired-end library (350 bp median insert) and HiSeq sequencing at Macrogen (Seoul, Korea), 151 bp paired-end reads
Oxford Nanopore ligation sequencing library (SQK-LSK110) on FLO-PRO002 PromethION flow cell at the Centre for Genome Innovation, University of Connecticut
Gut-tissue RNA extraction from 10 adult samples (Greytown, Jan 2023) with the InviTrap Spin Plant RNA Mini Kit (Invitek Diagnostics), -80 C storage
Paired-end RNA library with the TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit and Illumina HiSeq sequencing at Macrogen Europe (The Netherlands), 151 bp paired-end reads

headline.static_readiness: 0/27 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 20 of 27 computational steps (74%) reach the stage-1 ceiling RI under an inference-inclusive reading; 6 cap at NI and 1 at X. This paper is unusually well pinned at the tool-version level - FastQC v0.11.9, Trimmomatic v0.38, Guppy v5.1.12, JELLYFISH v1.1.12, racon v1.3.1, BWA v0.7.17, Pilon v1.23, BUSCO v4.0.5, RepeatModeler v2.0.2, RepeatMasker v4.1.2, HISAT2 v2.2.1, GenomeThreader v1.7.4, Blast2GO PRO v1.20.14, CLC Genomics Workbench v20.0.4, OrthoFinder v2.5.5, muscle v3.8.31, IQ-TREE v2.1.2, ASTRAL v5.7.7, RAxML v8.2.11 - but exact pins without environment closure hold the version axis at 1, and the axis cannot exceed 1 at stage 1 regardless. The binding limitation is the complete absence of an analysis code artifact: there is no code-availability statement, no GitHub/GitLab/Zenodo/figshare/OSF repository, no workflow file, no command line and no configuration file anywhere in the paper. NI steps are C2 and C4 (Trimmomatic invoked with no parameters at all, and Trimmomatic has no usable defaults), C7 (NECAT unversioned and its config file unreported), C13 (Purge Haplotigs unversioned with no coverage cutoffs), C20 (Blast2GO PRO on the proprietary CLC Genomics Workbench, a licensed GUI that cannot be scripted or redistributed) and C26 (the ultrametric transform feeding CAFE, for which no tool at all is named). C3 (Guppy basecalling) is X because the raw Nanopore signal data (fast5/pod5) are not deposited, so basecalling cannot be re-run from source. A secondary ambiguity runs through most of the assembly chain: the data statement deposits 'the assembled genome' under PRJNA1203571 and the raw RNA-seq under PRJNA1189815, but never explicitly states that the raw Illumina and Nanopore genomic reads are deposited; steps C1-C16 are scored data=2 on the inference-inclusive assumption that the genome BioProject carries the corresponding SRA runs, which a stage-2 or accession-level check would need to confirm. Even a perfect stage-2 code read cannot lift this paper to R-star because there is no code artifact to read.
headline.coverage: 27 computational steps assessed from Methods prose (sections 3.1-3.4); 6 wet-lab steps counted in W and not verdicted. A Data availability statement is present (two NCBI BioProject accessions). No code availability statement anywhere in the paper.

gaps.missing: No analysis code artifact of any kind. There is no code-availability statement, no repository (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/figshare/OSF/Code Ocean/Software Heritage), no workflow definition, no driver script, no command line and no configuration file. A full-text scan for github/gitlab/bitbucket/zenodo/figshare/osf/dryad/codeocean returned zero matches. The only URLs in the Methods are vendor/tool homepages (FastQC at bioinformatics.babraham.ac.uk, RepeatModeler and RepeatMasker at repeatmasker.org). The entire 27-step assembly and comparative-genomics chain exists only as prose.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit an analysis repository (GitHub plus an archived Zenodo DOI) containing the NECAT config file, the polishing loop scripts (minimap2/racon/BWA/Pilon iterations), the Purge Haplotigs invocation with its cutoffs, the BUSCO/RepeatModeler/RepeatMasker/HISAT2/GenomeThreader/Braker3 commands, and the OrthoFinder/muscle/IQ-TREE/ASTRAL/RAxML/CAFE comparative-genomics scripts including the ultrametric transform.

gaps.where: Software environment for the whole assembly, annotation and comparative-genomics pipeline
gaps.missing: No conda environment file, no lockfile, no requirements file and no container image or digest. Exact point versions are given for 19 tools, but there is no environment closure: no operating system, no compiler/interpreter versions, no Perl/Python/R versions underlying RepeatMasker, Braker3 and the phylogenetic tools, and no BLAST/Diamond/GeneMark/Augustus versions for the dependencies invoked inside NECAT, Braker3 and OrthoFinder. NECAT, Purge Haplotigs and the ultrametric-transform tool carry no version at all. This is exact-pins-partial, not an environment lock.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish a conda-lock or container digest covering the full toolchain including in-pipeline dependencies (Augustus, GeneMark/ProtHint, Diamond, BLAST), and state versions for NECAT, Purge Haplotigs and whatever produced the ultrametric tree.

gaps.where: C1-C16 (raw genomic read inputs); C3 (Nanopore raw signal)
gaps.missing: The data statement reads verbatim: 'The assembled genome Gonipterus sp. n. 2 has been deposited in NCBI (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/) under the accession number PRJNA1203571. The raw RNA sequencing data was deposited in NCBI with the accession number PRJNA1189815.' It commits only to the assembled genome and the RNA-seq reads. Deposition of the raw Illumina genomic reads and the basecalled Nanopore reads is never stated, and the raw Nanopore signal data (fast5/pod5) are definitely not deposited, which makes the Guppy basecalling step (C3) unreproducible from source.
gaps.how_to_close: State explicitly which SRA run accessions under PRJNA1203571 hold the Illumina and Nanopore genomic reads, and deposit (or state the unavailability of) the raw Nanopore signal data together with the Guppy basecalling model/config.

gaps.where: C2 and C4 Trimmomatic; C8 minimap; C13 Purge Haplotigs; C19 Braker3; C20 Blast2GO; C23 IQ-TREE; C25 RAxML; C27 CAFE
gaps.missing: C2/C4: no Trimmomatic steps, adapter file, quality thresholds or minimum length - the tool has no usable defaults, so the trimming is not reconstructable. C8: no minimap2 preset for Nanopore data. C13: no Purge Haplotigs coverage cutoffs (-l/-m/-h) or thresholds. C19: no Braker3 hint construction, GeneMark/ProtHint settings or Augustus training parameters. C20: no BLAST database, e-value or annotation cutoffs behind the Blast2GO run. C23/C25: no substitution model, model-selection criterion, partitioning scheme or bootstrap settings for IQ-TREE and RAxML. C27: no CAFE lambda/error model, family-size filtering, or the significance threshold used to call the 437 expanded and 110 contracted families (only figure-legend asterisk levels).
gaps.how_to_close: Report the exact command line for each of these invocations, ideally by releasing the pipeline scripts.

gaps.where: C14 BUSCO lineage; C16 RepeatMasker repeat library; C18 InsectBase proteomes; C20 Pfam/Blast2GO databases
gaps.missing: Reference resources are named without release identifiers. BUSCO 'insecta_odb10' is given without the ODB10 release date. RepeatMasker is run without stating the Dfam/Repbase library version or search engine. The comparative proteomes are described only as selected from 'InsectBase (Accessed in June 2023)' - an access date, not a database version, and the per-species genome/annotation accessions behind Table 2 are not given in the Methods prose. Blast2GO/CLC carry no BLAST database name, no GO release and no InterPro/Pfam release beyond the domain identifier Pfam = 00067.
gaps.how_to_close: Pin every reference resource by release identifier and provide a per-species table of proteome accessions and annotation versions, plus a download/build script.

gaps.where: C20 Blast2GO PRO v1.20.14 on CLC Genomics Workbench v20.0.4
gaps.missing: Functional annotation and the entire P450 gene identification (Pfam = 00067) - the central result of the paper - were performed inside a commercial, licence-gated GUI application. There is no scriptable invocation, no exportable workflow definition and no redistributable configuration. A reader without a CLC Genomics Workbench licence cannot re-run this step at all, and the 119 P450 gene calls therefore depend on an artifact that is neither open nor recorded.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the resulting annotation tables (per-protein GO terms, Pfam hits and the final P450 gene list with coordinates), and additionally re-run or cross-validate the domain assignment with an open tool (e.g. InterProScan/hmmscan against a pinned Pfam release) so the result is independently checkable.

gaps.where: C8 minimap; C10 BWA; C22 muscle; C23 IQ-TREE
gaps.missing: Tool identity is ambiguous in four places. 'minimap 2.0' is cited to Li 2018 (minimap2) but 2.0 is not a released minimap2 point version. 'BWA v0.7.17' is cited to Vasimuddin et al. 2019, which is the BWA-MEM2 paper, whereas 0.7.17 is a BWA (not BWA-MEM2) version. 'muscle v3.8.31' is cited to Edgar 2022, the Muscle5 paper, whereas 3.8.31 is MUSCLE v3. 'IQ-TREE v 2.1.2' is cited to Kalyaanamoorthy et al. 2017 (ModelFinder) rather than to IQ-TREE itself, and no model-selection setting is stated. In each case the version string and the citation point at different software.
gaps.how_to_close: Correct the tool/citation pairings and report the exact binary and version actually executed for each step.

gaps.where: C23 IQ-TREE gene trees; C24 ASTRAL species tree; C25 RAxML branch-length optimisation; C27 CAFE
gaps.missing: No random seed is reported for any stochastic step. Gene tree search, species tree inference, branch-length optimisation and CAFE's likelihood optimisation are all seed-dependent, so the published trees and the 437/110 expansion/contraction counts are not bit-reproducible.
gaps.how_to_close: Set and report seeds in the released scripts, and deposit the intermediate gene trees, the concatenated alignment, the species tree and the ultrametric tree as supplementary files.

gaps.where: C7 NECAT assembly; C9/C11/C12 polishing chain; C19 Braker3; C21 OrthoFinder; C26 ultrametric transform
gaps.missing: No intermediate artifact from the pipeline is deposited: neither the raw NECAT assembly, nor the per-iteration polished assemblies, nor the pre-purge primary assembly, nor the repeat library, nor the Braker3 hint files, nor the OrthoFinder orthogroup tables, nor the gene trees / concatenated alignment / rooted and ultrametric trees. Only the final assembled genome is deposited, so no step in the middle of the chain can be independently checked or restarted.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the key intermediates (repeat library, masked genome, structural annotation GFF, protein FASTA, orthogroup assignments, alignments and all trees) alongside the assembly.

gaps.where: W1-W6: HMW DNA extraction, gut-cleared DNA extraction, Illumina TruSeq library and HiSeq sequencing, Nanopore SQK-LSK110 library and PromethION sequencing, gut RNA extraction, TruSeq Stranded mRNA library and HiSeq sequencing
gaps.missing: Wet-lab sample collection, extraction, library preparation and sequencing are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W, not verdicted. Note that these sections are the most precisely documented part of the paper (kit names, temperatures, rcf values, coordinates, dates), which contrasts with the absent computational code.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; scope is the assembly, annotation and comparative-genomics chain.
